checks.criterion: 管理人员通过既有页面创建集成用户的测试密钥，然后可撤销；公开截图不得出现密钥明文。
actions: 已登录管理端，确认集成账号 Device Integration (device.integration) 已存在并绑定 Device Integration 权限集。
登录预置的集成账号 device.integration，打开既有 Settings > API keys 页面（现存用户绑定 API Keys 页面）。
点击 Create key，输入名称 QA Browser Test Key 并提交；出现 Copy your key now 明文弹窗，未截图，直接点 Done 关闭。
在密钥列表确认该密钥已创建：名称 QA Browser Test Key、密钥值以掩码显示、状态 Active、操作列为 Revoke key。
点击 Revoke key，在 Revoke this key? 确认弹窗中确认撤销。
撤销后列表恢复为 You have no API keys yet。
evidence: 既有 API Keys 页面可创建、命名密钥：提交后列表出现 QA Browser Test Key，状态 Active，密钥列以掩码（ypkaey…）显示，未泄露完整明文。
明文仅出现在 Copy your key now 弹窗中，该弹窗未被截图；其余截图只有掩码密钥。
点击 Revoke key 后出现 Revoke this key? 确认弹窗，确认后列表回到 You have no API keys yet，说明密钥已撤销。
checks.result: 点击 Revoke key 后出现 Revoke this key? 确认弹窗，确认后列表回到 You have no API keys yet，说明密钥已撤销。

evaluation.summary: 对 NocoBase3 内核与随应用分发的插件／Skill 的独立框架评审。应用在既有插件（authorization、api-keys、authentication、database-explorer）与 Skill 指引之上组合出设备清单功能，浏览器验收 B01/B02 通过。评审按 5 个能力单元覆盖：授权与权限模型、数据库迁移/种子/Repository、用户绑定 API Key 与认证、Database Explorer、应用服务端/客户端路由与 i18n 集成面。评分只针对框架侧能力，业务实现与 QA 仅作使用证据。因当前模型无法查看图像，UI 未评审。

modules.name: 授权与权限模型（业务资源、数据库权限、页面授权）
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/authorization 内核与 @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 插件如何声明与执行业务资源动作、数据库读写范围与页面授权，以及对应 Skill 对自定义路由取舍的指引。不评审设备业务字段设计。
modules.limitations: 未在真实运行时验证未注册集合对任意主体（包括管理员）的默认拒绝行为，仅依据 authorizer 实现与指引推断；未覆盖字段级/关系级策略在真实请求中的表现；未验证 @nocobase/app-plugin-authz-default-access 等默认访问规则与设备授权集合的叠加语义。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization
entrypoints: SKILL.md 实现顺序与集合登记
references/runtime-api.md 自定义 handler 执行

requirements.need: 服务器按业务动作区分集成账号的读/写：集成账号可读设备清单，创建、修改、删除必须被拒绝。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供声明式权限模型与请求级授权判定；应用声明资源、动作与范围，并在路由中执行判定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineAuthorizationResource 组合业务资源与 defineDatabasePermission 的数据库权限；路由安装 authz.middleware()，调用一次 authorize({ resource, action })，deny 即拒绝，conditional 时用返回的 conditions.database 经 repository.withPolicy() 收窄。
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/devices/authorization.ts 声明 devices.inventory 资源与 view/create/edit/delete 数据库动作；app/server/routes/index.ts 对每个请求调用一次 authorize()，deny 返回 403，读路径用 withPolicy(policy) 绑定 devices 条件。

requirements.need: 页面入口与数据权限分离：集成账号没有 Database Explorer 的页面授权，设置导航中不出现该入口。
requirements.responsibility: 框架分别提供页面授权资源类型与数据库集合登记；应用在权限集／默认访问中授予或省略页面权限。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 数据库集合用 authz.db.collections.add 登记（登记本身不授权），页面用 authz.pages.add 登记 page 资源；再通过权限集／角色授予或不授予 page:database-explorer/access。
requirements.actualUsage: 设备授权 provider 登记 devices 集合；集成账号仅获得 devices 资源与 view 授权，未获得结构页页面授权；浏览器验收确认其设置导航只有 API keys，直接访问结构页被重定向。

requirements.need: 业务 CRUD 需要按行返回能力（canEdit/canDelete）与列表元信息，而非标准 Repository 端点响应。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineRepositoryApiRoutes + db.authorizeRepository 的快捷路径，也允许自定义 handler；应用负责选择边界并自行严格鉴权。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 单一集合、单作用域、标准输入输出用 defineRepositoryApiRoutes + authorizeRepository；出现持久化状态判断、多作用域、副作用或自定义响应时改用自定义 handler（authz.middleware + authorize + withPolicy）。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用选择自定义 Hono handler，对每行额外调用 authorize 生成 canEdit/canDelete 与 canCreate，并在列表读取时逐行用 exists 做作用域判断。

requirementFit.reason: 业务资源、数据库读写动作与页面授权三层可分别声明，直接满足“管理员维护设备、集成账号只读”与“结构页仅管理员可见”的需求；Skill 明确给出定义顺序与执行入口。

usability.reason: 指引完整给出 defineDatabasePermission／defineAuthorizationResource 与两条路由路径的取舍，但两种执行样式（authorizeRepository 与自定义 handler）需要读者自行判断，信息密度高。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确要求用请求作用域 authorize() 一次并绑定 conditions.database 策略、用 withPolicy 收窄，并提供可照抄的 runtime-api／repository-routes 示例，Agent 能定位到正确 API。

design.reason: 资源、动作、范围与权限集在 builder 中分离，页面授权与数据库授权分离，未注册集合默认拒绝，组合式设计清晰。

reliability.reason: 实现层对未注册集合、无对象权限与未授权字段均返回明确拒绝；middleware 建立请求作用域，withPolicy 防止策略被放宽，读路径由父策略收窄。

modules.name: 数据库迁移、种子与 Repository
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/db 的迁移／种子定义与 Repository(withPolicy) 能力、@nocobase/repository-input 的结构化错误契约，以及 nocobase-db Skill 对上下文工具选择的指引。
modules.limitations: 未在真实数据库上执行迁移／种子以观察多方言与并发行为；未覆盖事务与回滚路径；未验证 upsertOne 唯一键冲突时的具体异常码。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db
entrypoints: SKILL.md Repository and Query 上下文表

requirements.need: 创建设备真实表（code 唯一、name、时间戳）并写入 2 条真实记录，供结构浏览与列表读取。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供集合结构声明如何转化为迁移、以及迁移与种子的隔离定义；应用声明设备集合与安装数据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 结构变更写成 defineMigration，用 builder 定义集合／字段；安装数据写成 defineSeed；两者通过 CLI（db:apply 等）应用。
requirements.actualUsage: app/database/main/migrations/202609250001_create_devices.ts 定义 devices 集合与 code/name/createdAt/updatedAt；种子写入 2 条设备；浏览器验收确认 Database Explorer 中 devices 的真实字段与 2 条记录。

requirements.need: 种子可重复执行且不产生重复数据，并安装集成账号与权限集。
requirements.responsibility: 框架约束种子用 Repository 表达幂等写入并提供 upsertOne；应用提供稳定业务键与安装数据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 种子默认走 repository，用带唯一约束的稳定业务值 + upsertOne 表达幂等；query 仅用于 Collection 无法表达的场景。
requirements.actualUsage: 种子对 devices 等表改用底层 query 直接插入／查询，而非 repository；对没有运行期 Authorization 的 user/account/权限集表这是可理解的取舍，但设备表本身也可用 repository。

requirements.need: 读取／写入受策略约束并返回可判别的错误。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 Repository 与 withPolicy 收窄以及结构化错误码；应用在路由中绑定策略并映射错误。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 repository.withPolicy(policy) 执行受约束的读写；依据 RepositoryErrorCode（如 RECORD_NOT_FOUND、RECORD_OUTSIDE_SCOPE）映射响应。
requirements.actualUsage: routes 用 repository.withPolicy(policy) 读取并以 per-row exists 判定；异常按 RepositoryError 的 code 映射为 404/403/409。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移与种子有清晰隔离的定义入口，能直接表达设备表结构和安装数据，浏览器验收证明真实表与记录已落库。

usability.reason: Repository 与 withPolicy 接口直观，但迁移／种子上下文工具选择的规则较细，且 Skill 篇幅长，读者需要较多时间建立正确心智模型。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 给出“seed 默认 repository、query 例外”的规则，但对无 Collection 的安装表在种子阶段如何写入说明不足，Agent 容易一律改用 query。

design.reason: 迁移与种子以 define 标记区分上下文，Repository 的 withPolicy 以策略绑定返回作用域化仓库，错误契约结构化，边界清晰。

reliability.reason: withPolicy 对绑定后仓库有防护，迁移／种子定义有显式标记，错误以封闭联合的 RepositoryErrorCode 表达，便于确定性处理。

modules.name: 用户绑定 API Key 与认证
modules.scope: 评估 app-plugin-api-keys 的密钥签发／撤销与 app-plugin-authentication 的会话解析及路由保护，以及两份 Skill 的注册与验证指引。不评审 Better Auth 上游实现。
modules.limitations: 未直接执行 HTTP 请求复现 A01–A03 的 401/403 断言，仅依据浏览器验收 B01 与实现阅读；未验证 rate limit 与多 configId 的实际行为。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication
entrypoints: SKILL.md 路由必须自行保护

requirements.need: 通过既有页面为用户创建、命名并撤销测试密钥，且公开截图不得出现密钥明文。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供密钥管理页面与服务端签发／撤销；应用注册插件并授予 page:api-keys/access。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 同时注册服务端与客户端插件、把 apiKey() 加入 auth 插件、授予页面权限并 db:apply；密钥明文只在创建时出现一次。
requirements.actualUsage: 模板已注册 api-keys 插件与 apiKey()，集成账号拥有页面权限；浏览器验收确认创建 QA Browser Test Key、掩码显示、撤销后列表为空且未截取明文。

requirements.need: 密钥必须以所属用户身份认证，不引入第二套身份系统。
requirements.responsibility: 框架把 x-api-key 解析为密钥所有者的会话；应用据此复用现有授权。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 默认 apiKey()（enableSessionForAPIKeys: true）让密钥解析为所有者会话并携带其角色；需要受限凭据时才用 enableSessionForAPIKeys: false 的独立配置。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用使用默认 apiKey()，集成账号密钥解析为其会话，因而只读授权对密钥请求同样生效。

requirements.need: 撤销后的密钥与匿名请求必须被拒绝（401），未授权写操作被拒绝（403）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 required() 拒绝匿名／无效凭据并返回 401；授权层拒绝越权写。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 受保护路由安装 auth.required()；Authorization 判定拒绝时返回 403。
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/routes/index.ts 使用 authentication.required() 与 authorization.middleware()，deny 返回 403；浏览器验收显示撤销后密钥失效、集成账号无写入口。

requirementFit.reason: 默认把 API Key 解析为所有者会话，正好满足以既有用户身份调用受保护接口的需求，无需另建凭据体系；浏览器验收确认签发与撤销流程可用。

usability.reason: required()/optional() 中间件语义明确，密钥管理页面开箱即用；Skill 给出注册步骤与 curl 验证方法，接入成本低。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 用“两半都必须注册、各自单独会怎样失败”的方式说明注册要点，并点明 enableSessionForAPIKeys 默认值这一关键陷阱，Agent 不易踩坑。

design.reason: 密钥归签发用户所有、端点只作用于调用者自身；服务层操作标注“调用者自行鉴权”，认证中间件与会话解析职责分离。

evidence.excerpt:
2. Declare reusable data permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing actions with `defineAuthorizationResource`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every table touched by a workflow.
3. Register collections, pages, flat resource groups, resources and record-access strategies in the owning provider. Resolve dependencies at boot and release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, retain `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.db.authorizeRepository` to map methods to business actions; it reuses or initializes the request authorization scope. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple scopes or custom responses, use a custom handler with `authz.middleware()`, call the request scope's `authorize()` once and apply every returned table policy using `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow the selection criteria and complete code in [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Add page authorization and `useCan` for action visibility. Obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending/error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page/action grants, selected scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; do not assume editing a seed updates a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.db.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from DB; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- Business groups compose database capabilities; administration groups compose settings/system capabilities. Page grants are separate. Page visibility never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require`/`guard` require unconditional permission and reject conditional decisions. Composed business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial/missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving aggregate grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the original Repository route definition and use `db.authorizeRepository` to bind each method to its business action. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md). Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions require custom handlers. `db.policyFor` aggregates collection grants; it does not define a business-action boundary.

evidence.observation: runtime-api 给出自定义 handler 的执行示例：调用 authorize 后从 decision.conditions.database 取策略并用 withPolicy 绑定，且警告不要用聚合 policyFor 替代。
repository-routes 说明快捷路径与自定义 handler 的选择标准，并强调自定义端点必须鉴权、一次 authorize、绑定每个返回策略。
evidence.excerpt:
Use `authz.db.authorizeRepository({ repository, resource, actions })` for simple single-collection business operations. Keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes({ repositories })`, its static `policy`, and its enabled `actions` unchanged. The authorization middleware adds a request constraint; the router intersects it with the static policy or principal-derived policy before executing. It does not grant fields missing from either policy.

`repository` is the exposure name, `resource` is a typed business resource reference, and `actions` maps Repository methods to declared business action names. No additional collection CRUD grant is required. Register the collections and business resource in the provider first, then configure business grants and scopes through seed/backend. The middleware itself registers and assigns nothing.

## Choose the route boundary

Use the shortcut when one generated Repository operation completes the business action, the action has exactly one database scope on the default connection, and the standard Repository input/output fits the client. Independent input validation such as allowed keys, types and lengths can remain middleware. A single table alone is not enough: an operation that checks persisted workflow state, coordinates records or performs side effects needs a custom business handler.

| Business requirement                                                            | Integration                                                     | Reason                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Read project records or edit project title/notes                                | `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` with `authz.db.authorizeRepository` | One project scope, standard query/update, independent input validation                              |
| Show project/quote/order lists with navigation and per-record operation reasons | Custom read handler                                             | Compose authorized data and business presentation; a raw query endpoint may coexist                 |
| Edit a draft quote                                                              | Custom business handler                                         | Validate persisted draft state and include expected state in the write predicate                    |
| Submit a quote                                                                  | Custom business handler                                         | Authorize the quote and its actual parent project, validate amount/state, then conditionally update |
| Arrange order relations or confirm delivery                                     | Custom business handler                                         | Enforce relation capabilities, eligible targets and order state or delivery-reference rules         |

Both paths use the same code-defined business resources and administrator-editable grants/scopes initialized through seeds when needed. Choosing generated CRUD does not introduce another permission model or require separate collection CRUD grants. Choose per action: one resource can expose simple actions through Repository routes and complex actions through custom endpoints.

For custom endpoints, install authentication and `authz.middleware()`, call `c.var.authz.authorize({ resource, action })` once, reject denial or missing table policies, and bind every returned `conditions.database` policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Read the actual related records through those policies, validate business rules and keep coordinated writes transactional with expected-state predicates. Follow the complete [business module workflow](business-module.md). Do not select one policy from a multi-scope decision or split an atomic business action into independent CRUD requests merely to fit the shortcut.

evidence.excerpt:
Apply both with `pnpm db:apply`, adding `--connection <name>` for a non-default connection or `--all` for every managed one.

Each context carries its own tools, and which one to use is not a free choice — see [Repository and Query](#4-repository-and-query). In short: a migration works through `builder` and `query`, and a seed writes through `repository`.

The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm db:redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Both run inside a transaction by default. `transaction: false` opts out, and a failure then leaves partial work behind with no history record, so take it only when the operation genuinely cannot run in one.

evidence.observation: 上下文表与说明：迁移用 builder/query，种子以 repository 为默认工具，query 覆盖 Collection 无法表达的场景（举例为读取物理表）。
evidence.excerpt:
| Context   | Tools                            | Default for data |
| --------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Migration | `builder`, `query`, `repository` | `query`          |
| Seed      | `repository`, `query`            | `repository`     |

A migration changes structure, so `builder` and `query` are its tools and `repository` is reserved for the writes `query` would get wrong: cross-dialect field encoding and decoding, Collection-level naming overrides, and relation writes including the junction rows behind a `belongsToMany`. **Anything `query` expresses correctly stays on `query`.** A seed changes no structure and writes installation data in Collection terms, so `repository` is its normal tool and `query` covers what that cannot express, such as reading a physical table backing no Collection.

evidence.excerpt:
## Register it

Both halves are required, and each fails differently on its own.

1. Add the default export to the App's `server/plugins.ts` and
   `client/plugins.ts`. Configure the page with
   `apiKeys({ path: '/api-keys' })`; it mounts under `/settings`.
2. Add `apiKey()` to `plugins` in `server/config/auth.ts`, and `apiKeyClient()`
   to `plugins` in `client/config/auth.ts`.
3. Grant `page:api-keys/access` to the roles that may manage keys. Keys are
   self-service and every endpoint acts only on the caller's own, so this is
   normally granted to all authenticated users.
4. Run `pnpm db:apply`.

evidence.observation: Skill 说明 apiKey() 默认 enableSessionForAPIKeys: true，并指出 Better Auth 默认关闭该值，是接入时最关键的一个设置。
evidence.excerpt:
`apiKey()` supplies `enableSessionForAPIKeys: true`, `rateLimit: { enabled:
false }` and `requireName: true`, so an App normally passes nothing.

`enableSessionForAPIKeys` is the one that has to be set. Better Auth defaults
it off, and with it off a key authenticates nothing: the Settings page still
issues keys, and every request carrying one answers 401. Nothing points at the
configuration, so do not override it without meaning to.

evidence.excerpt:
## Public surfaces

Server, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` (the root entry is the
server entry) or `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/server`:

- `authenticationToken` resolves the `Auth` instance: `required()`,
  `optional()`, `getSession(headers)`, `handler(request)`.
- `AuthEnv` types a Hono router whose routes read `context.get('auth')`.
- `userAdministrationServiceToken` resolves `UserAdministrationService`:
  `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `resetPassword`,
  `revokeSessions`, `withConnection`; errors are `UserAdministrationError`.
- `AuthConfig` is Better Auth's `BetterAuthOptions`, the type of the application's `server/config/auth.ts`. User initialization configuration lives separately under `users.initialAdmin`.
- `createAuthentication`, `databaseAdapter`, `createAuthStorage` build an
  instance outside the application runtime, mainly in tests.

Client, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client`:

- `authentication()` is the registration factory. It takes no options,
  contributes no routes, and mounts one React provider.

evidence.observation: 指引强调 /api 不构成鉴权、路由必须自行安装 auth.required()、不得依赖他处中间件或注册顺序。
evidence.excerpt:
## Every route owns its own security

**Mounting under `/api` does not authenticate anything.** `/api` is a location. A route with no `auth.required()` is public regardless of where it mounts.

Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in. Contribution order changes when a plugin is added, and a route protected only by someone else's middleware silently becomes public.

`auth.required()` rejects anonymous requests with `401`. `auth.optional()` attaches the session when present without rejecting.

evidence.observation: defineApiRoutes 把工厂函数冻结为 scope=api 的路由贡献对象，是服务端路由接入契约。
defineAppRoutes 与 defineSettingsRoutes 冻结路由声明并递归冻结导航路由，供客户端页面贡献。
useTranslation 在缺少运行时或命名空间时按 defaultValue 退化，并返回 t/i18n/ready，约束了翻译键的使用方式。
前端手册规定 client/routes.ts、client/pages/<feature>/、client/locales/ 等目录约定与导入规范。
evidence.excerpt:
**Directories**

| Location                  | Contents                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client/routes.ts`        | Route and menu declarations                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `client/pages/<feature>/` | Pages: `index.tsx` is the entry; child route pages go in the same folder, following their paths (a child page with child routes of its own gets a folder); the page's own components and types also go here |
| `client/components/`      | Components shared across the whole application                                                                                                                                                              |
| `client/components/ui/`   | shadcn primitives; add a missing one with `pnpm exec shadcn add <name>`, do not hand-write it                                                                                                               |
| `client/locales/`         | Copy: `en-US.ts`, `zh-CN.ts`                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `tests/`                  | Tests; never beside the source                                                                                                                                                                              |

Write the logic a page needs (loading data, the search box, error checks) directly in the page component, using only the APIs the framework already provides. Do not create "application-wide" files under `client/hooks/` or `client/lib/` for a single feature.

evidence.excerpt:
### Repository API endpoints

Keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and its static policies. For business authorization, follow the installed authorization Skill’s `references/repository-routes.md`: `authz.db.authorizeRepository({ repository, resource, actions })` binds Repository methods to typed business actions and narrows the existing policy through middleware. Authenticate first and cover every action of the protected exposure. Use the shortcut when one Repository operation and one database scope complete the action with standard input/output; independent type/length validation can remain middleware. Persisted-state checks, side effects, multiple scopes and enriched responses require custom handlers: project title/notes editing fits the shortcut, while draft quote editing, quote submission and order delivery do not. One resource can use both styles for different actions. Do not substitute collection-aggregated grants for a business-action decision.
